about: Two axes crossing into four named quadrants, with things dropped where they sit on both measures as each is named: urgent and important, cost and benefit, risk and reward, any two qualities at once.

axes.about: the ends of the axes: left|right|bottom|top

x.about: each thing's place across, 0 to 1, split by commas

y.about: each thing's place up, 0 to 1, split by commas

when.about: moments each thing arrives; else when its name is said, or one after another
